parameters.name: Dealed
parameters.description:
The status of the event. Valid values:

*   **y**: handled
*   **n**: unhandled
*   **a**: all statuses

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: **20**.

parameters.name: PortraitId
parameters.description: The ID of the attacker profile.

parameters.name: SrcIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the attack.
